pr_title: builtins: add digest and hmac functions
pr_body:
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/73864
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/73865

Release note (sql change): The digest and hmac builtin functions were
added. They match the PostgreSQL (pgcrypto) implementation. Supported
hash algorithms are md5, sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, and sha512.
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/73935)

issue_context.title: sql/builtins: support hmac builtin from pgcrypto
issue_context.body:
From https://www.postgresql.org/docs/14/pgcrypto.html

```
hmac(data text, key text, type text) returns bytea
hmac(data bytea, key bytea, type text) returns bytea
```

> Calculates hashed MAC for data with key key. type is the same as in digest().
> 
> This is similar to digest() but the hash can only be recalculated knowing the key. This prevents the scenario of someone altering data and also changing the hash to match.
> 
> If the key is larger than the hash block size it will first be hashed and the result will be used as key.

Epic CRDB-120
